ohtani.title: Emmet Sheehan's superb outing fuels Dodgers' 6-3 win
ohtani.blurb: Teoscar Hernández belts a three-run homer and Emmet Sheehan strikes out 10 to lead the Dodgers over the Reds, 6-3

imanaga.title: Shota Imanaga's strong start leads Cubs to 6-1 win
imanaga.blurb: Shota Imanaga tosses six dominant innings and Michael Busch slugs a home run to lead the Cubs to a 6-1 win over the Marlins

suzuki.title: Chourio's late-game heroics lead Brewers to a 4-3 win
suzuki.blurb: Jackson Chourio hits a go-ahead two-run single in the 8th and makes a game-ending sliding catch to lead the Brewers to a win over the Cubs

yoshida.title: Sonny Gray, Wilyer Abreu shine in 4-0 shutout win
yoshida.blurb: Seven innings of shutout ball from Sonny Gray and Wilyer Abreu's 22nd homer of the year lead the Red Sox to a 4-0 win over the Pirates

okamoto.title: The A's walk it off in the 9th
okamoto.blurb: Henry Bolte drills a home run and Jeff McNeil walks off the game with a  single to excel the A's 6-5 victory over the Blue Jays

murakami.title: Kyle Teel, Sam Antonacci fuel the White Sox 10-1 win
murakami.blurb: Kyle Teel crushes a three-run home run and Sam Antonacci hits a two-run double to lead the White Sox to a 10-1 win over the Twins

matsui.title: Campusano, Buehler lead Padres to 3-2 win
matsui.blurb: Six strikeouts from Walker Buehler and a walk-off two-run home run from Luis Campusano lead the Padres to a 3-2 win over the Yankees
